name: irsync
note: The design of the landing page and the book. site/tools/gen_tokens.py turns it into --ir-* CSS custom properties for both. Edited here.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Surfaces on the page: the book's sidebar, code blocks, tables, quotes.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on ground and raised.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: notes, metadata, footer.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: Multimode-fibre aqua as a fill: the route line and its stations. Not for text.

tokens.name: aqua-ink
tokens.usage: Aqua for text and controls: links, the primary button, focus outline.

tokens.name: on-aqua
tokens.usage: Text on an aqua or aqua-ink fill.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Single-mode yellow, kept for the beta badge and warning bar. A fill only, never text.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a signal fill.

tokens.name: term
tokens.usage: The terminal strip behind commands, dark in both themes.

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Command text on the terminal strip.

tokens.name: term-muted
tokens.usage: The prompt and other quiet text on the terminal strip.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: daisyUI's error colour on the landing page.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on an error fill.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text: the book's warning notes and string literals in code. Book only; the landing page does not use it.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Danger text: caution notes and deletions in code. Book only; the landing page does not use it.

tokens.name: aqua-soft
tokens.usage: Pale aqua ground: search matches, footnote highlight, menu hover. Book only; the landing page does not use it.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Pale yellow ground behind warn-ink. Book only; the landing page does not use it.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Pale red ground behind danger-ink. Book only; the landing page does not use it.

families.display: Barlow, Bahnschrift, "DIN Alternate", "Franklin Gothic Medium", sans-serif
families.condensed: "Barlow Semi Condensed", Bahnschrift, "DIN Alternate", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

type.note: A scale on a perfect fourth (4:3) from a 17px body. Sizes are in rem so a reader's font-size setting applies.

scale.name: lede
scale.usage: The introduction under the landing page headline.

scale.name: heading
scale.usage: Section headings; the book's page titles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Boxes: the terminal strip, code blocks, tables.
